EC1: - Any diagnosis of a disease that may affect the central nervous system (brain condition, [OR] traumatic brain injury, [OR] dementia, etc).
EC2: - Other psychiatric diagnoses [OR] or acute psychiatric illness (substance dependence [OR] or abuse, history of schizophrenia or other psychotic disorders, etc.), except for anxiety disorder [OR] or personality disorders.
EC3: - Presence of delusional ideas [OR] or hallucinations whether consistent or not with mood.
